### [GAMs]
#### Create GAM models.
#### Version 2. (DO NOT USE) Interactive term of lon, lat, treatment arm.
```{r eval=F}

df_all_2 <-
  df_all %>%
  mutate(isTreated_child =
           ifelse(as.character(isTreated_child)=="Control",1,2))

gammort_1to59_child2 <- gam(n_deaths_1to59 ~
                             s(lon, lat, isTreated_child) +
                             offset(log(pt_year_1to59)),
                           data=df_all_2,
                           family=poisson,
                           method = "REML")

gammort_1to59_child2 <- getViz(gammort_1to59_child2)

#plots by treatment arm v1
plot(sm(gammort_1to59_child2, 1),
        fix       = c("isTreated_child" = 2))
plot(sm(gammort_1to59_child2, 1),
        fix       = c("isTreated_child" = 1))

#v2
plotSlice(x = sm(gammort_1to59_child2, 1),
                fix = list("isTreated_child" = c(1,2))) +
  l_fitRaster() +
  l_fitContour()

#ATE
plotDiff(s1  = sm(gammort_1to59_child2, 1),
         fix = c("isTreated_child" = 2),
         s2  = sm(gammort_1to59_child2, 1),
         fix = c("isTreated_child" = 1))

#plots by treatment arm
plot(sm(gammort_1to59_child2, 1)) #Control
plot(sm(gammort_1to59_child2, 2)) #Treated

#ATE
plotDiff(s1 = sm(gammort_1to59_child2, 1),
         fix = c("isTreated_child" = 2),
         s2 = sm(gammort_1to59_child2, 1),
         fix = c("isTreated_child" = 1))

```

#### Version 3. (DO NOT USE) 11/7/2024 scratch work
```{r eval=F}

gammort_1to59_child_v1 <-  gam(n_deaths_1to59 ~
                              isTreated_child +
                              # s(lat,lon) +
                              s(lat,lon, by = isTreated_child) +
                              # s(lon,       bs = "cr", by = isTreated_child) +
                              # Matern(1|lat + lon) +
                              # s(site_code, bs = "re", by = dummy) + #est. surface well but people don't trust the SE calculation
                              offset(log(pt_year_1to59)), # re is on
                            data   = df_all,
                            family = poisson(link = "log"),
                            method = "REML")


summary(gammort_1to59_child_v1)

get_smooths_difference(model=gammort_1to59_child_v1,
                       #lat,
                       difference = list(isTreated_child = c("Control", "Treatment"))
                       )
```
